observations: The current backend executes one POST /api/search request and has no confirmation endpoint.
Each benchmark case needs an isolated session because the backend persists prior IQL state by sessionId.
Four V1 prompts relied on assisted editedIntent and must be made explicit for direct execution.

amb-001.question: show all security event records from the last 24 hours; this is a read-only search
amb-001.rationale: Use a broad read-only event search because V1 only requires a safe executable query.

amb-003.question: thong ke cac loi theo event_type, lay top 10
amb-003.rationale: V1 supplied TERMS_AGGREGATION, groupBy=event_type and topN=10 after confirmation.

amb-004.question: show error events during the second quarter of 2025
amb-004.rationale: Resolve the otherwise incomplete quarter into the year covered by the benchmark corpus.

amb-005.question: count error events grouped by timestamp_quarter using calendar quarter buckets
amb-005.rationale: Select the virtual timestamp_quarter dimension compiled to a calendar-quarter date histogram.

amb-007.question: count events by source, return the top 10 sources

amb-008.question: count all errors grouped by event_type, return the top 10 event types
amb-008.rationale: V1 supplied TERMS_AGGREGATION, groupBy=event_type and topN=10 after confirmation.

amb-009.question: show only events whose severity is critical
amb-009.rationale: The isolated V3 session has no prior query to patch, so the full search intent is stated explicitly.

llm-001.question: show events where event_type equals failed_login from the last 24 hours; these are authentication failure events
llm-001.rationale: Use the canonical event_type field required by the shared V1 ground truth.

llm-002.question: show the top 3 hosts with the most error or failure events, grouped by host
llm-002.rationale: Make the terms aggregation field, bucket count and error filter explicit.

llm-003.question: xu huong alert moi ngay trong thang nay, gom theo bucket 1 ngay
llm-003.rationale: V1 supplied TIME_AGGREGATION with a one-day bucket after confirmation.

llm-004.question: show event records containing the phrase connection timeout error
llm-004.rationale: Make the full-text search intent explicit.

llm-005.question: show event records containing signs of lateral movement attacks
llm-005.rationale: Make the full-text lateral-movement search intent explicit.

tmp-003.question: show auth events grouped over time by day from June 1 through June 15 2025
tmp-003.rationale: Make the date histogram required by the V1 ground truth explicit.

tmp-004.question: show endpoint events since June 1 2025
tmp-004.rationale: Provide endpoint as an authoritative structured event_type constraint.

tmp-006.question: count events per day from June 1 through June 15 2025 using one-day buckets
tmp-006.rationale: Make the daily date histogram explicit.

tmp-007.question: count error events grouped by timestamp_quarter using calendar quarter buckets from 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z through 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
tmp-007.rationale: Use the virtual quarter dimension and exact year boundaries required by the shared ground truth.
